name: The Shadowserver Foundation (public ASN and network API)
tier_rationale: Established security non-profit named among the trusted operators by A8 (Shadowserver) with published terms; P033 chair rationale: 'All three operators are established non-profits or CERTs: tier trusted'.

reliability.justification: BGP-derived origin ASN and announced prefixes from Shadowserver's routing view; usually reliable, may lag routing changes by hours.

net_api.title: Shadowserver public net/asn API (keyless): ?origin=<IPv4> -> origin ASN, AS name and prefix; ?prefix=<ASN> -> announced prefixes

terms.quote: Registry (A1 BR3, A8 BR12): PeeringDB (free under its AUP), CIRCL BGP Ranking (free CIRCL service) and the Shadowserver public API (free public-benefit service) are 'open', tier trusted, each with evidence recorded.

net_api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P033 cond 1); the documentation page (verified 200 on 2026-11-26) points to https://github.com/The-Shadowserver-Foundation/api_utils/wiki and states no further terms. Keyless GET only (P033 cond 5); a key, if one is ever used, goes in a header. Unknown and invalid inputs are echoed as [{"ip": "<query>"}] with HTTP 200: the module validates its input first and reads an echo without 'asn' as 'no origin data'. Failures are 'could not verify'. The reports API on transform.shadowserver.org (apikey + HMAC) is out of scope (P033 cond 6: registering the company's own netblocks is an institutional DPO/IT decision documented in docs/LEGAL.md): no module declares that host. Used by asn_context.

notes: Created by batch p2-G02-1 (P033 asn_context). transform.shadowserver.org is registered here so the reports host has an owner and a tier; nothing calls it in this build.
